figurative_meaning_en: In mockery, a very ugly person
similar_in_english: as ugly as a mud fence
example_sentences_in_bangla: নতুন বধূকে দেখে সবাই বলল, বেগুন গাছে আঁকশি!
ওর চেহারা দেখলে মনে হয় বেগুন গাছে আঁকশি লাগানো হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone said about the new bride, she's like a hook on an eggplant tree!
Looking at her face, it seems like a hook has been hung on an eggplant tree.
note: Traditionally used in jest towards young brides; considered irrelevant in modern times.
